title: Bible PAL traditional story meta
description: JSON Schema for per-story metadata files at assets/stories/traditional/{sid}/meta_{sid}.json. additionalProperties is false at every level to catch silent leak fields (e.g. the rVK incident: reflectionVoiceKey leaking into ~167 metas). New top-level fields require an intentional schema change.

storyVoiceKey.description: Narrator voice. Enum is the union of all values currently shipping in the corpus. Source of truth for *new* authoring is scripts/story_factory/story_voice_registry.py:APPROVED_NARRATOR_VOICES + the character voices documented in feedback_voice_rules.md. Banned-for-new voices (LILY_WOLFF, PETER_BOLD, MARCUS_ANCHOR, JOSEPH_DREAMER) and legacy retired voices (JOHN_DOE, CHRIS_DEFAULT) remain in this enum so existing metas validate; new authoring should still go through validate_story_voice().

voiceKey.description: Legacy duplicate of storyVoiceKey (115 metas in the 1000-series cohort). Allowed but not required; new authoring uses storyVoiceKey only.

ttsModel.description: RENDER-CONFIG DOCTRINE: the audio-generation pipeline (scripts/generate_opus_audio.sh) is the single source of truth for what was actually sent to ElevenLabs. For stories rendered before 2026-06-14, ttsModel/ttsVoiceSettings in meta may not match the real render config and are NOT authoritative — do not bulk-reconcile the corpus. New stories should record the pipeline's actual settings at render time. Never assert meta == pipeline in tests/validators; it fails on legacy. (As of 2026-06-14 the pipeline hardcodes eleven_turbo_v2_5.)

ttsVoiceSettings.description: See ttsModel description for the render-config doctrine: pipeline is authoritative; pre-2026-06-14 metas may drift; do not bulk-reconcile or test meta == pipeline.

source.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Provenance marker for the 800-series cohort produced by the retired STORY_FACTORY v2.3 pipeline. Observed only on storyIds 801-834.

generationContractVersion.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Pipeline contract version string used by the retired STORY_FACTORY v2.3 cohort (storyIds 807-834).

voiceKeys.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Per-length voice override map from the STORY_FACTORY v2.3 cohort (storyIds 809-834). Superseded by the single canonical `storyVoiceKey` field.

boundaryValidation.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Per-length pass/fail marker from the STORY_FACTORY v2.3 pipeline (storyIds 827-834).

wordCountFlags.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Per-length word-count audit record from the STORY_FACTORY v2.3 pipeline (storyIds 826-834). Modern bucket gate is enforced by scripts/validate_corpus.py.

skippedLengths.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Records intentionally-skipped lengths in STORY_FACTORY v2.3 (storyIds 827, 829). Modern flow: omit the length from `lengths` and don't add a `files.{length}` entry.

reflections.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). Object form of reflection filenames keyed by lane (web/kjv), observed on storyIds 1016-1071. Superseded by `files.reflection.reflectionText` and `files.reflection_kjv.reflectionText`.

storyTextV3.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). v3 TTS audio pilot variant, observed only on storyIds 1121 and 1122.

reflectionText.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). 801 anomaly: reflection content inlined under a length entry instead of under files.reflection.

reflectionAudio.description: LEGACY (grandfathered, do not write in new generation). 801 anomaly: see reflectionText description.
